review.review: Independent bounded release UI review using .claude/AUDIT_RUBRIC.md
review.result: Passed bounded release UI review. No remaining verified P1/P2 defects in the corrected candidates and sampled states; full acceptance remains open.
review.sourceScope: Shared focus/responsive CSS consolidation; scanner filter targets/state labels; live setup input labels and acknowledgment target; journal row targets, P&L text and calendar contrast; native paper history/trace actions; lesson flip-face accessibility and regime labels; replay setup controls. No API mutations or source edits by reviewer.

rubric.1_scope_intent: Authorized UI simplification and release polish. Review bounded to current rendered controls, readability and keyboard access; no whole-system acceptance claim.
rubric.2_fundamentals: Current callers, styles and input labels inspected. Fixture source status determines live setup redirect, so idle setup was checked separately from running LONG status. SVG fill and text opacity included; CSS composition estimates do not fully capture vector-painted backgrounds.
rubric.3_contracts_ownership: Settings values/parsing, filter handlers, timing definitions and financial calculations remain owned by existing producers. Named native actions replace click-only surfaces; no session/cache or strategy owner introduced.
rubric.4_behavioral_evidence: 92 rendered route/chapter-by-width cases; focused trace, paper autopsy, flip-card/rejection keyboard tests; 8 final setup/journal retests. No broad test suite rerun by reviewer. Root owns final compiler/unit/build validation.
rubric.5_accounting_diagnosability: No accounting producer or financial handler changes; numerical sign/P&L values retained while calendar tint and text opacity changed. Offline failures visible in fixtures.
rubric.6_safe_verification: Installed Edge headless with all /api calls intercepted. Zero mutation requests; no credentials, API imports, runtime stores, exchange operations or unrestricted backend tests.
rubric.7_trading_assumptions: No weights, thresholds, mode minimums, order behavior or teaching calibration altered. Scanner out-of-mode status now explicit without changing filter behavior.
rubric.8_reviewable_completion: Current diffs inspected; source ownership preserved. Initial defects and corrected retests retained separately. A08/A09 broader scope and Level07 remain open. No additional scoring recommended for CSS consolidation.

renderedMatrix.routes: 14 active/fallback routes plus nine authored chapter routes

checks.keyboard: Trace Enter opens; Escape restores focused native trigger. Paper Enter expands and Space collapses; phone summaries fit. FlipCard exposes one active face, hidden face inert, Space/Enter and visible focus pass. Rejection chip focus and aria-expanded pass. 650px title is24px.
checks.correctedContrast: Journal calendar and percentage/subtitle text, scanner mode labels and regime quadrant labels have no remaining computed contrast candidates in sampled states.

clockRetest.visual: Opaque bg-2 label backplates and full-opacity fg labels checked in320px and1280px screenshots. Zone arcs and timing preserved.

review.resolvedFinalConcern: KillZoneClock same-color-on-arc labels now have opaque bg-2 backplates and fg text. Final targeted four-width retest supersedes the ASIAN contrast candidate in the92-case matrix.
